description: List the OAuth Apps registered in your tailnet (Tailscale alpha). Returns an `oauthApps` array describing each app (id, name, redirect URIs, scopes). Client secrets are NOT included -- a secret is only returned once, by tailscale_create_oauth_app at creation time. This is how you recover the id of an app you did not record; pass that id to tailscale_delete_oauth_app to revoke it.
name: tailscale_list_oauth_apps
title: List OAuth apps
